description.defaultText: Read complete ordered command-preview changes with original zero-based ordinals and exact totals; stored sources are rejected. Omitted limit defaults to 50; explicit limits are 1–200.
Read one complete typed stored Workforce entity by its matching kind and stable identity, without host-owned extension maps.

Read stable-ID-ordered entity summaries. Search is a literal Unicode-lowercase substring of at most 256 UTF-8 bytes; empty matches all and unnamed kinds require empty search. Omitted limit defaults to 50; explicit limits are 1–200.
Read Required and Preference catalog descriptors with implementation support from the existing compilation authority, not backend availability or feasibility.

Inspect one person and resolved shift using the implemented assignment graph, with remaining Required-rule count and ordinal-paged typed rejection causes. This is not whole-model feasibility. Omitted limit defaults to 50; explicit limits are 1–200.

Read configured availability occurrences for one person, clipped and deduplicated by existing temporal authority and ordered by availability identity, start and end. The nonempty half-open date window is at most 366 local calendar days. Omitted limit defaults to 50; explicit limits are 1–200.
Read configured type membership, not solver feasibility, for unique existing typed-ID axes in request order: at most 128 people, 64 assignment types and 8,192 cells. Every requested cell is returned.

Read the existing whole-document generation reconciliation as ShiftId-ordered before/after/change rows and exact totals. Optional presentation dates include either before or after local start date and span at most 366 days; changesOnly uses authoritative change kinds. Omitted limit defaults to 50; explicit limits are 1–200.
Read captured scenario settings and exact stored structural counts, including all 13 entity kinds and stored active flags. No completeness, applicability or feasibility judgment is inferred.
Read one complete typed Required rule or Preference record, with the requested class and stable rule identity.

Read stable-ID-ordered rule summaries in one class. Omitted or null kindId selects all; a supplied kindId must be an existing catalog kind in that class. Omitted limit defaults to 50; explicit limits are 1–200.

Inspect the existing scope helpers over the full captured horizon with exact people, shift and Cartesian population counts and a stable-ID page for the selected axis. Minimum-rest before/after parts require the matching rule kind. These are selected populations, not constraint or feasibility counts. Omitted limit defaults to 50; explicit limits are 1–200.

Read-only stored-source preparation of explicit scenario settings by resolving local midnight horizon boundaries with existing Workforce planning-date authority. The desired whole horizon is not subject to the 366-day presentation-window cap. No mutation or continuation is accepted.
Read one fully resolved shift and its complete typed template or stored instance source. Generated occurrences are never represented as directly editable stored entity records.

Read resolved shifts whose original local start dates fall in a nonempty half-open window of at most 366 calendar days, ordered by start instant and ShiftId. Omitted limit defaults to 50; explicit limits are 1–200. Display durations preserve exact seconds and nanoseconds.
Add one typed Workforce entity, validate the resulting state and retain an exact inverse.
Add one typed Workforce assignment lock, validate the resulting state and retain an exact inverse.
Add bounded occurrence definitions across templates atomically without replacing template fields; retain one exact ordinary inverse.
Add one typed Workforce Preference, validate the resulting state and retain an exact inverse.
Add one typed Workforce Required rule, validate the resulting state and retain an exact inverse.
Move an owned occurrence identity into the supplied one-off shift, including an explicitly edited interval. Inactive definitions may become active stored shifts; review the generation diff.

Remove bounded unreferenced occurrence definitions atomically; exact raw definitions are retained in the ordinary inverse.
